title: CoRect: Context-Aware Logit Contrast for Hidden State Rectification to Resolve Knowledge Conflicts

bias_targets.methodology: Contrasting logits from contextualized and non-contextualized forward passes using the Logit Lens technique to identify and rectify intermediate hidden layers where the model's memorized pre-training priors suppress contradictory external evidence, evaluated on knowledge-conflict QA benchmarks like NQ-Swap.
